data.title: General Provisions of Crocobet
data.content:
General Provisions 

 

1.       Through the present systematic-electronic form the rules of organizing slot machine games   (hereinafter referred to as rule or/and regulation) are agreed with the Revenue Service of Ministry of Finances of Georgia and establishes through the systematic-electronic form rules of organizing slot machine games   and the terms of participation in them.    

2.       Slot machine games are organized in a systematic-electronic rule by "Full House" LLC (hereinafter referred to as the Company, and/or Crocobet, and/or the Organizer), which holds permit No. 19-11/001.

3.       “Full House" LLC (ID/C 405143303) , Authorization certificate #GE-CA-A0003, issuing the certificate  “Random Systematics Georgia” LLC (ID/C 405323948);

4.       Through the systematic-electronic form, via internet there is organized and operable website  on the address:   WWW.CROCOBET.COM on which there are uploaded games and gambling is going on according to the  rules  specified in such regulation. The website operates 24 hours a day. The management and organization of games on electronic slot machines is carried out at the physical address: N16a str. Ateni, Tbilisi.

4.1. The server infrastructure addresses of Crocobet:

·         N2 avenue Tsereteli, Tbilisi, Georgia – Cloud9  LLC (405063755);

·         N160 str. Tsinamdzgvrishvili, Tbilisi, Georgia   - Caucasus Online LLC (211380833);

·         N16a str. Ateni, Tbilisi, Georgia;

·         N1 str. Tabidze, Tskaltubo, Georgia.

5.       Before starting the registration and playing, the players  (hereinafter referred to as player or/and user) are obliged to familiarize themselves with the rules for organizing games on slot machines in a systematicatic and electronic form, which are posted on the website in order to protect the rights of players (www.crocobet.com) . Otherwise, no claims will be accepted regarding issues that have been published on the website and accordingly, their publicity has been ensured.

6.       All players are obliged to familiarize themselves with these rules before registering on the company's website WWW.CROCOBET.COM and placing a bet. Not be familiar with the  game rules will not be accepted as an argument for canceling the bet,  to resolve another disputed issue or to release from liability.

7.       By registering and placing a bet, the player agrees to the game rules established by the company.

8.       Participation in gambling and/or winning game is prohibited for Georgian citizens under the age of 25, foreign citizens/non-citizens under the age of 18, for persons on the lists of dependent and/or prohibited persons as well.

9.       Bets are accepted from persons who are citizens of Georgia over the age of 25, citizens of a foreign country over the age of 18/non-citizens, from persons who are not included in the lists of dependent and/or prohibited persons as well, who agree to the company's gaming rules.

10.    After registering on the company's website, the user is assigned a PIN code, which is individual for each player and through which the user can deposit or withdraw money from the company. The PIN code is confidential and it is prohibited to alienate it or give it to a third party by the player.  In a such case, the company administration completely disclaims all liability for any damage caused, and the player is imposed by such liability.

11.    Each registered player must have only one gaming account. A registered player cannot register again. For violation of this rule, the company administration reserves the right to block such a gaming account. In case of two or more gaming accounts, the company also reserves the right to block him/her on the site, not allow it to participate in any raffles and/or any events organized by Crocobet, and completely restrict him/her use of the site.

12.    The Company will process the personal data of the players based on their consent. In the mentioned processing, the Organizer fully relies on and complies with the rules and standards established by the legislation of Georgia, including (but not limited to) the Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection.

13.    Registration, identification and verification of each player, the processing of personal data the player  transferred to the Company as well, is carried out in accordance with the legislation of Georgia and the rules and form established by these Regulations. The rules and technological description of storing the  personal data of the  players are detailed in these Regulations.

14.    Crocobet reserves the right, in accordance with the requirements of the  legislation of Georgia to make changes and/or amendments  to the Rules, which will be agreed in written manner with LEPL  Revenue Service.

15.    In case of any questions/complaints related to the personal data protection rules, please contact us at the following addresses: Vake district N16a str. Ateni Tbilisi, Georgia, E-mail: support@crocobet.com.

16.    Player registration/identification/verification form and blocking procedure:

 

16.1. Player registration

 

To use the games provided by the Company, the Player initially goes through the registration stage. During registration, the Player, based on his/her consent, provides the Company with the various personal data. The Player provides the Company with the following personal data at various stages of registration:

 

·          Player's first and last name;

·          Player's date of birth;

·         Player's personal identification number (if any);

·         Identity and/or citizenship document number, date of issue, issuing country, issuing authority and validity period;

·         Player's gender;

·         Player's citizenship;

·         Place of birth – country (and city – if available);

·         Registration address;

·         Actual place of residence;

·         Player's active phone number;

·         Player's chosen username;

·         Player's email address;

·         Player's password;

·         Confirmation that the player agrees to the rules/terms, is at least 25 years old in the case of a citizen of Georgia, and at least 18 years old in the case of a citizen of a foreign country, is not on the list of prohibited and/or dependent persons, and will not allow other person(s) to use his/her gaming account.

·         Confirmation that the player is not on the sanctioned list;

·         Any other information that can be used to identify and/or communicate with the player, at the discretion of the organizer.

·         User systematic log data, IP address, browser information, Internet service provider information, operating system and computer device information, number of clicks and user interaction with the website (www.crocobet.com), user navigation history on the website (www.crocobet.com), time of entry to the website (www.crocobet.com) and user location, COOKIE records and WEB BEACON files (data stored on the user's browser, which are usually used in combination and which provide the Organizer with the information about the user's navigation on various websites);

·         Any other information that the user voluntarily leaves on the website (www.crocobet.com) or otherwise provides to the organizer, including the fact that the user has agreed to this policy document. In addition, some types of information are processed automatically or semi-automatically, including through Google Analytics or programs developed by other third parties;

·         During registration a user, the user will undergo strong (in order to complete the registration and verify the phone number specified in the registration data, a short-term one-time code is sent to the phone number specified in the registration data as a short text message) or two-step authentication (an authentication method that uses two components to identify the player's identity. In addition to the password, this can be the answer to a special question, a physical or electronic one-time or multiple-time code, or any biometric data).

·         Change of a user's name and surname, date of birth, personal or passport numbers are permitted only by the relevant authorized body, in accordance with the procedure established by the law, in the case of changing biometric data. Violation of this rule will automatically result in the cancellation of verification.

 

16.2. Identification of players

 

Since, the user has provided the company with their personal data based on their consent (partially or in full, as required by the registration rules and the company), he/she will proceed to the identification stage.

Identification may be completed both at the box office designated by the organizer, and online, according to the rules determined by the organizer.

 

User identification will be carried out in the following cases:

 

·         Before establishing a business relationship with the user;

·         Before concluding a one-time transaction with the user;

·         After the user registration;

·         In a risk-based approach (in cases considered risky transactions / actions within the company's discretion);

·         When changing the data of a user;

User identification includes the following:

·         An authorized employee will verify the information/documentation submitted by the user at any stage for the purposes of identifying the user and distinguishing them from other individuals;

·         User identification by an authorized employee of the company is carried out upon submission of an identity document by the user and verification of the person's identification data in the electronic database of the LEPL - State Services Development Agency.

·         In order to complete the identification stage successfully, it is mandatory that the information/documentation submitted is clearly legible, valid up to date and authentic. This will be verified by an authorized employee of the company;

·         An authorized employee may ask the user to complete/specify/update/submit additional information submitted once or multiple times (at the discretion of the company's). In exceptional cases (at the discretion of the company), the user may be asked to connect via video call;

·         Additionally, the user may be required to submit an additional information/documentation as determined by the Company, including but not limited to translated/notarized documents.

The need for user identification, in addition to initial registration, may also arise:

·         If there is a doubt about the accuracy of the client's identification data or compliance with the requirements set forth by law; or

If it becomes known about a change in the client's identification data at any time determined by the Company.  In the event that such case is not directly specified by  this policy document, the organizer will inform the user about this through appropriate communication.

 

16.3. Verification of a player

 

After registering and identifying a user, in order to be granted verified user status and be able to participate in the games organized by the company, they must complete the verification stage.

 

A unique code will be assigned to the verified player.

 

Verification may be completed both at the box offices designated by the organizer and online according to the rules determined by the organizer.

Verification will be carried out in the following cases:

 

·         Before establishing a business relationship with the user;

·         Before concluding a one-time arrangement  with the user.

·         After the user has registered;

·         In a risk-based approach (in cases considered risky transactions / actions within the discretion of the company);

·         When changing the data of the user

·         For the purposes of complying with the requirements of the Law of Georgia on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism, including in the following cases:   Receiving cash, making a profit or disbursing cash, if the amount/value of the transaction or the total amount/value of related transactions exceeds GEL 5,000 or the equivalent of GEL 5,000 in foreign currency.

·         Verification is carried out on the basis of documents specified by the legislation of Georgia, in accordance with one of the rules below, at the discretion of an operator:

1.       For the purpose of player verification on the website, a  photo of the player must be submitted, taken with a valid ID card or passport, where the   identification data of the document is clearly readable, the photo and face of the player are visible;

2.       Via video call, using a method determined by the organizer. The image received via video call must allow the identification of the person;

3.       Through direct contact with the player, during which the operator will verify him/her face to face;;

4.       Through a technological solution that uses biometric data to determine the identity of the person depicted in a photograph taken and a photograph of an identification document and/or a photograph obtained from the electronic database of the LEPL - State Services Development Agency.

5.       By sending a short-term one-time code via text message to the  active phone number of the player. Remark: Verification in this form can only be performed during the period following the initial verification, in order to pass subsequent verification(s). 

 

·         User re-verification

From the date of verification, the user will undergo re-verification process annually (no later than 5 business days after the end of each continuous 12 calendar months) according to the following procedure:

a) A short-term one-time code will be sent to the  active phone number of the user in the manner of a short text message;

b) The identification data of the person holding a Georgian citizenship and residence permit will be verified in the electronic database of the LEPL – State Services Development Agency;  The identification data of all users will be checked against the list of prohibited  and dependent persons and the list of sanctioned persons.

 

16.4. Player account blocking rules

 

·         In order to block a personal page of “Crocobet”, the user must come to a “Crocobet” branch and/or a service box office designated by the organizer and write a statement. The statement can also be sent to the email address specified on the site (support@crocobet.com). In this case, the user undergoes re-verification, sends a statement from the registered email, which must be accompanied by a picture of the user (so-called selfie). The profile of the user will be blocked within 10 business days from the receipt of the statement;

·         A personal page of the user may also be blocked at the request of an authorized body, in accordance with law of Georgia;

·         In the event of fraud, violation of fair play or other suspicious and/or any actions by the player, which may result in material and/or moral damage to the company, or damage to its "business reputation", the company reserves the right to:

- block access to the website of player;

- cancel the account and refund the player the amount owed to him/her;

-  address the relevant authorities regarding the identified fact in accordance with the current legislationof  Georgia,.

·         Crocobet reserves the right to prevent a user blocked on the site from participating in any raffles or/and any event organized by Crocobet,   even if this user has received a ticket for any draw and/or event organized by Crocobet before or after blocking.

·         The company reserves the right to refuse a player from registering on the website or placing a bet without any explanation.

 

17.    Rules and technological description of storing the personal data of a player:

 

·         By registering, all users agree that their personal data will be checked and processed in accordance with the current legislation of Georgia for the following purposes: (1) providing the user with the service and product selected by him/her; (2) fulfillment of obligations established by the legislation of Georgia by the Company; (3) fulfillment of rights and obligations established by the general rules and terms posted on the website of the organizer; (4) implementation of financial monitoring measures;

·          Data may only be stored for the period necessary to achieve the purpose for which the data are processed. After achieving the purpose for which the data are processed, they must be blocked, deleted or destroyed or stored in a method that excludes the identification of a person, unless otherwise is specified  by the law;

·         The data processor is obliged to store the information specified in this policy for the registration/identification/verification of a person in a specially created electronic database/archive for at least 5 years. This information is confidential and its transfer to a third party is permitted only in the cases specified by the legislation of Georgia.

18.    The organizer takes such organizational and technical measures that ensure the protection of data from accidental or unlawful destruction, alteration, disclosure, acquisition, any other form of unlawful use, and accidental or unlawful loss.

19.    List of Internet platform/system protection mechanisms:

·         Information systems include operating systems, software, third-party standard products, and business process support information systems developed by Crocobet employees or provided by the third parties. In order to create, acquire, and configure information systems successfully and effectively, information security requirements must be taken into account during their planning stage, when developing design requirements.

·         Audit

In order to identify threats, mitigate risks, and ensure compliance with regulations, Crocobet reserves the right to organize and conduct an internal audit procedure at its discretion.

·         Human Resources Management

In order to identify human error and intentional harmful actions, to insure employees, and to reduce incidents, Crocobet is constantly implementing and improving appropriate control mechanisms, such as minimum privilege, onboarding, off-boarding, and position change procedures.

·         Physical security

To ensure physical security, a security service operates in Crocobet. The building is also equipped with video surveillance and fire protection systems, in accordance with Resolution No. 41 of the Government of Georgia. Physical security standards also apply to the data centers where from the company provides services, which means placing information processing equipment in a secure/protected area.

·         The mentioned policy may be modified based on regulatory changes, internal organizational business needs, or new challenges in cyberspace, by a competent person or group, in consultation with the manager.

 

20.    Detailed description of the recording and storage of financial transactions

 

 

20.1. The deposit of funds intended for gaming by users is done (so called fill of deposits) through various channels.

 

 

•          Bank channels   - (through E-commerce)

 

 

a) TBC Bank JSC

 

b) Bank of Georgia JSC

c) By other commercial banks licensed in Georgia

d) Apple Pay

e) Payment Schemes:

  • Visa International
  • MasterCard International
  • American Express Credit Card

Instructions for deposit of funds via Payment Schemes:

Payment via VISA, Mastercard, and Georgian Card:

To deposit fund on your account, select the corresponding card, specify the transfer amount, and click "Continue." The system will redirect you to the bank's secure platform, where you must enter the following details:

  • Card Number: Enter the 16-digit number found on the front of the card.
  • Expiry Date: Select the expiration month and year of the card.
  • CVV2 Code: Indicate the three-digit security code located on the back of the card.

Afterward, click "Deposit Balance." You will receive a one-time authorization code from the bank on your mobile phone; enter this into the designated field and complete the operation by clicking the "Pay" button.

If you wish, you may select "Remember Card" so that you do not have to re-enter your details in the future.

Deposit of funds with an American Express (AMEX) Credit Card:

When using an AMEX credit card, choose the payment method specifically designated for this card. Enter the amount and, if desired, check "Remember Card." After clicking the "Deposit" button, you will be redirected to the bank's page, where you will provide:

  • The 16-digit card number (from the front).
  • The card's expiration date.
  • The 4-digit code located on the front of the card.
  • For confirmation, enter the code received via SMS and click "Pay."

Important Information:

  • Please note: When transacting with an American Express credit card, a service fee (3% of the amount) will be deducted.

Only balance deposit operations are permitted with this specific card.

 

The funds deposited are reflected in the bank accounts of Full House LLC within the terms specified in the contract.

The user is obliged to comply with the requirements of both the legislation and the payment schemes.

Withdrawing Funds to VISA, Mastercard, and Georgian Card

To transfer funds from your balance, please follow these steps:

  1. In your personal account, select the "Withdrawal" section.
  2. Under payment methods, select Visa/Mastercard/Georgian Card.
  3. Choose the desired card and specify the amount you wish to withdraw.
  4. To complete the operation, click the "Continue" button, and the funds will be reflected on your bank account.

Mandatory Conditions:

  • To transfer funds to a card, the card must be verified.
  • Additionally, it is required that you have made at least one deposit (balance top-up) with this same card previously.

 

When withdrawing a deposit by  a user, the amount is charged from the bank account in accordance with the terms and procedure specified in the contract.

20.3. The winnings are credited to the  gaming account of the user by crediting the amount no later than five days after the winnings are observed.  The individual withdrawal limit for each user is determined at the discretion of the operator by the relevant department.

20.4. The user has limits on both depositing and withdrawing funds. The minimal deposit is GEL 0.5 (zero point five tenths), and the maximum amount that can be withdrawn is GEL 51,500.00 (fifty-one thousand five hundred). The maximum withdrawal limit includes the commission fee of the company;

20.5. A third party may withdraw funds from another user's account from the platform of the Organizer only if all three of the following conditions are met: (1) the said user has the status - Verified; (2) The third party must submit a notarized power of attorney in accordance with the legislation Georgia, which must clearly state the aforementioned authority; (3)  Own personal identification document. An authorized employee will check the submitted documentation, assess the existing risks, and make a decision on the possibility of withdrawing funds by a third party.

21.    In the event that a player mistakenly transfers money to someone else's personal number while depositing own balance, the administration of the company disclaims any responsibility for the refund of the said money or its transfer to another gaming account.

22.    Deposits and withdrawals to the balance can be made both in cash and via wire transfer/cashless. Deposits and withdrawals via wire transfer/cashless are possible through partner banks and other electronic deposit facilities. Cash payments are possible at the following addresses:

Additional rules:

 

1.       The   "password" of the user is confidential and cannot be disclosed or transferred to another person. The user is directly responsible for the security of the "password".

2.       In case of loss of the "password", its transfer to another person, or theft, the "organizer" fully disclaims any liability for the damage caused. The responsibility is imposed directly on the player.

3.       The Company reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to refuse a user from registering on the website and/or placing a bet without explaining the reason of the refusal.

4.       In the event that the user mistakenly transfers the amount to another personal number/person at the time of depositing balance/cashing/withdrawing money from electronic systems (instant payment machines, Internet payments, etc.), the "Organizer" shall not be liable for the refund and/or transfer of the said amount. The amount mistakenly transferred to another personal number/person may be refunded to the user only on the basis of applicable legislation.

5.       Only verified users can withdraw money from their gaming account. Users can withdraw money from their gaming account at any time. The organizer is not responsible for the processing/reflection time of the payment service provider.

6.       In case of changing the  personal data of the user (name, surname, address, date of birth, e-mail), the "Crocobet" administration reserves the right not to issue the winnings to the registered user as a result of the change, within 24 hours from the moment of the change.  Winnings can be withdrawn from the "Crocobet" online cashier only after this period has expired and/or before the change based on a notarized power of attorney issued by the registered user.

7.       The amount won by the user will be automatically credited to his/her gaming account, and the amount lost will be automatically charged from his gaming account.

8.       If the amount on the  balance of the user is less than the minimum bet, the bet placed by him/her will not be recorded. "Crocobet" does not consider playing with credit.

9.       In case of improper and dishonest use of the balance on the "Crocobet" website (when depositing the balance through electronic systems and other means and, accordingly, in case of not placing a part of the available amount on a bet in the "Crocobet" system), "Crocobet" reserves the right to deduct up to 20% of the withdrawn amount as a commission at the time of withdrawal of the amount available at the gaming account of the user.  

10.    The company reserves the right to suspend the gaming account or charge funds from those individuals who use www.crocobet.com for improper purposes.  If a player does not use at least 30% of the funds deposited into his/her gaming account for gambling in good faith (when the principle of randomness is not violated), the company reserves the right to restrict such users from using the gaming account and withdrawing funds for at least 60 days in order to determine the reason for this action of specific players, and the company also reserves the right to charge 20% of the withdrawn amount from the player in the case of such amounts.

11.    Any technical or mechanical failure will be considered an extraordinary circumstance. In case of any malfunction during payment on the part of the "Company", all payments will be canceled/MalfunctionVoidsAllPays.

12.    In the event that the data was entered incorrectly and as a result of this error the user was credited with an excessive amount, the "Organizer" reserves the right to recalculate the winning amount and charge the amount credited to the player by mistake, or vice versa.

13.     Claim review deadline and method:

·         The period for reviewing a claim does not exceed 30 calendar days from the date of the arising of a claim.

·         The claim is accepted on the basis of a written application (via registered e-mail). The claim will be reviewed by the relevant department of Full House LLC. After the claim is reviewed, considering the deadlines, the final decision will be submitted in written manner to the claiming user.
